name: chart
title: Chart
description: An Operator Black categorical bar chart using the shared solid data palette and deterministic growth

variables.label: Palette
variables.description: Bar colours: the four categorical data tokens, one accent stepped down into the surface, or a neutral grey ramp.

variables.label: Spacing
variables.description: Gap between bars, which also decides how wide each bar is inside the fixed chart width.

variables.label: Growth
variables.description: What the progress value scales: rise grows bars up from the baseline, sweep wipes them in from the left at full height.

variables.label: Caption
variables.description: Figcaption text, also used to rebuild the figure's accessible label.
